WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as first_mean
  FROM order_averages
),
orders_above_first AS (
  SELECT 
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.avg_remain,
    oa.avg_remain - fb.first_mean as excess_first
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark fb
  WHERE oa.avg_remain > fb.first_mean
),
second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as second_mean
  FROM orders_above_first
),
orders_above_second AS (
  SELECT 
    oaf.ordersmark,
    oaf.avg_remain,
    oaf.excess_first,
    oaf.avg_remain - sb.second_mean as excess_second
  FROM orders_above_first oaf
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb
  WHERE oaf.avg_remain > sb.second_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remain) as avg_of_remaining,
  AVG(excess_first) as avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(excess_second) as avg_excess_over_second
FROM orders_above_second
